messages:
maya-cs: Flagging NeptuneCare pilot 1: nightly ingest dropped to ~20% last night, embeddings and rerank jobs stalled. Marking renewal-watch.
jon-am: Any alerts? Rita, did enablement change prompts or schedules?
rita-csm: Champion Priya is on leave; procurement lead Theo paused heavy jobs citing noisy outputs and unexpected ordering.
sam-eng: Quick triage: no infra OOMs. Found increased 502s on batch-run endpoint around 02:05 UTC. Sample log: `2026-01-09T02:05:12Z ERROR embed-batch grpc deadline exceeded`
sam-eng: Also ran a model diff; rerank v5 shows ordering flips vs v4. Pinning NeptuneCare traffic to v4 (canary).
ops-bot: routing-pin-710 applied to 2 canary hosts. health checks running.
maya-cs: I'll notify Theo and offer a 20-min QA session + quick checklist.
jon-am: Drafting a small commercial gesture if they resume: 1-week pilot credit + priority debug. Hold until QA outcome.
rita-csm: Preparing checklist (5 smoke prompts, expected ordering, where to find logs) and will run assisted QA with procurement.
ops-bot: canary healthy. rolling to remaining hosts (ETA ~7m).
sam-eng: After pin, rerank ordering matches baseline on our 30-case set. Blocking v5 rollout for NeptuneCare until further eval.
maya-cs: Update sent. Theo requested fallback behavior note and cost delta v4->v5. Setting renewal-watch and pairing CSM+AM. :thumbsup:
